description: Aider-polyglot style (Kotlin, hard): measure a volume with three jugs (fill, empty, pour) in the minimum number of moves. A shortest plan is rarely unique, so the instructions pin a breadth-first search with a fixed move order and first-discovery parent, and the tests compare exact move lists, while a replay checker rejects illegal or no-op moves. Also covers zero target, impossible targets and argument validation. A plain Kotlin test runner compiled by run_tests.py is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs it for a repair round.
